data.explanation: This letter from the radiology practice confirms your MRI scan appointment for your right knee on 03.02.2026 at 14:15. Arrive 15 minutes early at the ground-floor reception, and bring your health insurance card (Versichertenkarte), the doctor's referral (Überweisung), and any previous scan results (Vorbefunde) if you have them. Remove any metal objects before the scan. If you cannot make it, contact the practice by phone or email as soon as possible to reschedule; there is no penalty stated in this letter, but missing the slot means you'll need a new appointment.
